nodes.title: 1. DISK CHAIN: Start, review or resume a shot
widgets_values: Replace the selected person in <Video 1> with the same character shown in <Picture 1>. Keep the reference character's face, hair, body proportions and clothing. Follow the source performance's pose, gaze, expression, gestures, object interactions and movement at the source timing. Preserve the source scene, lighting, camera and other people. The selected performer is replaced, not duplicated.

nodes.title: 2. STATUS: open /_swap/chain on the same 8188 address
Read before Run
widgets_values: Upload your full video and character image to /workspace/input using FileBrowser or an existing Load node, then refresh the file lists. Use a UNIQUE run_name for a new shot. Queue ONCE. The control node returns quickly; a separate Pod process queues the short rendering jobs. Open /_swap/chain on this same service for progress, seam previews and review controls. Do not queue other generation while it runs. Auto checks are heuristics, not a guarantee. Review every chunk is the stricter manual-approval option. Resume keeps the recorded settings; changing this node does not edit an existing run. No Ollama inside the loop.
